title: docs(mcp): resources are served on the stdio transport only; name the HTTP tools that read the same data
body:
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJSRdLSMks47MshHcmtLwgx)_ domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAUev5V62cLHhQwBi ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：只改 `@objectstack/mcp` 的 README 和一个 patch changeset，不动代码。README 在三处写明 MCP 资源（`objectstack://…`）只在 stdio 传输上提供；通过 HTTP（`/api/v1/mcp`）连接的客户端要读同样的数据，用 `list_objects`、`describe_object`、`get_record` 三个工具。 - 为什么改：原来的 README 列了四个资源，没说只在哪种传输上有，托管和 Docker 部署的客户端读了会以为 HTTP 上也能浏览资源。实测 HTTP 上 `resources/list` 回 -32601 Method not found，文档和实际行为对不上。座位裁定按方案 B 修文档，不在 HTTP 上新增资源。 - 风险与回滚：纯文档改动，运行时行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。 - 先看：`packages/mcp/README.md` 的 § Resources，新增的「资源 → 工具」对照表。 - 两分钟验证：`git show --stat HEAD`，应只有 README 和 changeset 两个文件；读 § Resources 的新段落。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 Fixes #32438 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -e "objectstack://" -e "resources/list" -- 'skills/**' 'packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts'` has no hit; no skill or the rendered SKILL.md mentions resources ## What changes `packages/mcp/README.md` documented the four `objectstack://` resources with no transport caveat. They are registered by `bridgeResources()` on the long-lived server only, and its one caller is the stdio start path in `plugin.ts`. `handleHttpRequest()` builds a fresh server per request and registers no resource, so its derived capabilities honestly omit `resources`. The README now says so in the three places the seat's ruling names: - **Features**: the Resources bullet is marked stdio-only and names the HTTP tools. - **§ Resources**: it opens with "served on the stdio transport only". A new paragraph says the HTTP endpoint advertises no `resources` capability and answers `-32601` to `resources/list`, `resources/templates/list` and `resources/read`. A table maps each resource to the tool that reads the same data under the same caller's principal (`list_objects`, `describe_object`, `get_record`). `objectstack://metadata/types` has no HTTP counterpart. - **§ Server capabilities**: `resources` appears on the stdio server only, and the HTTP endpoint never advertises it. One changeset: `@objectstack/mcp` patch, because the README ships in the npm package. Ruling: option B, seat comment 6811836163 on #32438. ADR-0036 Phase 2 scopes the HTTP door to tools, and ADR-0101 places resources on the long-lived stdio server. Serving resources over HTTP would be a Clause-② widening with its own card. ## Tests No pin and no ablation: no code changes, and no gate reads `packages/mcp/README.md` (`git grep -n "mcp/README" -- scripts '.github' 'packages/*/src' 'packages/*/scripts'` has no hit). The behaviour the text now states was measured on `main` `e765a092` through the real door:
Measured: pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p 38732, an osk_ key from POST /api/v1/keys, Bearer on POST /api/v1/mcp ``` == initialize {"result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{"prompts":{},"tools":{"listChanged":true}},"serverInfo":{"name":"objectstack","version":"18.3.0"},...} == resources/list {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"error":{"code":-32601,"message":"Method not found"}} == resources/templates/list {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"error":{"code":-32601,"message":"Method not found"}} == resources/read objectstack://objects {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"error":{"code":-32601,"message":"Method not found"}} == control: tools/call list_objects {"result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\n \"objects\": [\n {\n \"name\": \"crm_account\", ... ```
## Verification Gates were run on the change commit `2b3d026a`, before the merge of `origin/main` (`7642648f`; `git diff e765a092 origin/main -- packages/mcp/` is empty): - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/mcp/README.md .changeset/32438-mcp-readme-resources-stdio-only.md` → 50 commands, each exit recorded to a file before any pipe. Then `--ran`: `50 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 50 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, all exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 (prerequisite: shallow clone). After `git fetch origin 621a4876…` it passed 48/48. - `pnpm lint` → exit 0. - No package typecheck or suite is owed, because no TypeScript changed. Full dogfood: n/a. The title has no `!` and Clause-② has no `(narrowing)` arm. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01Utp6Cb2vksWyoMWrYYgiCW)_
